evidence: The thickness of the films ranged from 10 to 310 nm, and the average growth rate was 0.1 nm per deposition cycle. Measured ρ of the films was 5.3(1) g/cm and remained constant within the whole thickness range. Surface roughness was estimated to be about 1.1(3) nm for the films with t ≤ 40 nm. A rapid increase of σ at t =4 0–80 nm and its leveling off at 3.2(3) nm in the thickness range of 80–150 nm was observed.
